name: Andron's Payment to Jediga
summary: Andron asks you to carry his note to Jediga in Azshara. The payment brings an unexpected extra share.

sections.title: A Generous Payment
sections.body: Jediga reacts with surprise when you bring Andron's note to her in Azshara. She says Andron paid far more than expected and wonders whether you told him the agreement had changed, or whether he was drunk again. She gives you an extra share as well.

faq.q: What does Andron ask me to deliver?
faq.answer: Andron asks you to deliver his note to Jediga in Azshara.
Jediga is the one who receives Andron's note in Azshara.

faq.q: Why did Andron pay too much?
faq.answer: Jediga wonders whether you told Andron the deal had changed or whether he was drunk again.
Jediga gives you an extra share after you deliver Andron's note.
